To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

magnetic susceptibility of soils developed under birch stands of different age in the vicinity of a copper-processing plant is positively correlated with the age of the stand, which is a result of pedogenic processes.
the magnetic susceptibility of recultivated topsoil is a good indicator for the approximate age of forest stand.

the magnetic enhancement in soils of different age in the vicinity of the copper-processing plant is of pedogenic nature and that it is possible to use magnetic parameters to estimate the age of the soil.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of magnetic methods for assessing the degree of soil development and restoration after remediation of Cu-processing waste dump.
the application of environmental magnetic methods for assessment and monitoring of soil restoration in a recultivated area, which is a new approach for application of magnetic methods.
the application of magnetic methods for monitoring the degree of restoration of soil in areas influenced by metallurgical processing of copper ore.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environmental magnetic methods applied are useful for monitoring soil development in terms of soil formation processes and soil fertility.
the magnetic methods applied are useful in assessment of soil restoration after recultivation of waste material in the vicinity of Cu-processing plant in Bulgaria.
the magnetic methods applied provide a useful tool for assessing the degree of restoration of soils in the vicinity of a Cu-processing plant.

magnetic methods are a useful tool in the assessment of soil development and restoration in the vicinity to metallurgical copper-processing plants.   1
magnetic methods can be successfully applied for assessment of soil development and soil restoration after recultivation of areas affected by mining and processing activities.
